description: A ViewModel class for managing workout details and UI state in an Android app. Handles loading workout data asynchronously using coroutines.

classes.name: WorkoutViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel responsible for fetching and exposing workout details, thumbnails, and loading state to the UI.

methods.name: loadWorkout
methods.description: Fetches workout detail and thumbnail asynchronously based on provided workout ID, updating LiveData objects accordingly.
